subject.title: fix(node-pairing): require operator.admin to approve fs.listDir nodes (#105936)

question: Should every new node pairing that declares `fs.listDir` require `operator.admin`, matching the existing invocation gate even though write-scoped operators could approve these pairings previously?
rationale: The code establishes admin as the execution boundary, but tightening approval changes an existing operator workflow and therefore needs an owner to confirm that the stronger trust decision is intentional.

options.title: Enforce approval parity
options.body: Require admin at both pairing approval and invocation, then merge after the refreshed exact head passes required checks.

options.title: Preserve weaker approval
options.body: Keep write-scoped pairing approval and close or redesign this PR only if approval is intentionally allowed to be weaker than execution.

recommendation.title: Enforce approval parity
recommendation.body: Require admin at both pairing approval and invocation, then merge after the refreshed exact head passes required checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected `fs.listDir` capability and its stated admin filesystem boundary originate in the recent feature commit.
